title: evaluator's out
description: What the evaluator gives as it ends: its result, its last message, and its Answers. evaluator.md names this file.

result.description: The fixed word the evaluator gives as it ends, by running python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lane/result.py evaluator done. The routes go on by this word.

reply.description: Its last message: how many necessary conditions of its group it put in good and in more.

answers.description: The evaluator's Answers, in the file that its run value answers names, which rn's check reads at done: each necessary condition of its group in good, with the lines of the deliverable that meet it, or in more, with good_when, and each point open that only the user can settle.

lines.description: Each line of the work that meets it, as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.

good_when.description: What the work's user gets once the work is good, in their terms, never how to make it, because the generator holds the sources and mends the work in its own way.

question.description: The question the point bears on, by its ID.

what.description: The point that only the person can settle.
